Title: First Night 
Genre: Dark alt-rock/nu-metal 
Song Description: First Night” is a dark, intimate metal love song about finally giving in after months of pretending the feelings aren’t there. Clean guitar and deep bass open the track beneath GrandpaHazard’s low, raspy close-mic vocals before exploding into heavy, aching choruses driven by the desperate refrain, “I’m yours.”
The song captures the overwhelming moment when two people finally close the distance—shaking hands, racing breath, and all the emotions they’ve been trying to suppress.
